err.no_cols: No column detected in the header.
reco.desc.email: Salted SHA-256 hash (pseudonymization) or drop if not needed.
reco.desc.phone: Mask middle digits or salted hash; keep country prefix if useful.
reco.desc.name: Drop or replace with an alias / technical id without direct link.
reco.desc.id: Reversible encryption (pseudonymization) with separately managed key.
reco.desc.health: Sensitive data (GDPR art.9): drop unless strict necessity + legal basis.
reco.desc.quasi_id: Generalize (year, age band, region) to restore k-anonymity.
